text: Which of the following is NOT an advantage of cell-free protein synthesis systems compared to cell-based expression?
choices: Fast design-build-test cycle: design to test in about 4 to 8 hours versus days for cell transformation
Toxic reaction products can be tolerated without killing the system
Self-replicating, allowing indefinite scale-up without reconstituting new reagents
Sensors and measurement devices can be added directly into the open reaction
explanation: Cell-free systems are explicitly not self-replicating -- every new reaction must be reconstituted from extract or purified components, which the chapter lists as a disadvantage rather than an advantage. The other three options are genuine advantages: a fast design-build-test cycle, tolerance of toxic products since there is no living cell to kill, and the ability to add sensors directly to the open reaction.
